headline: BLOB BATTLE: chains, counters, and a friend over the internet
lede: An original head-to-head chain battler lands in the arcade — glossy orbs, popping cascades, garbage warfare — solo against a chain-hungry CPU, two players on one keyboard, or online over four-letter room codes. One deterministic sim runs all three.

notes.text: Clear 4+ same-color orbs and they pop; the collapse re-pops — every chain step rains grey rows on your rival, and clearing while garbage is queued COUNTERS it. First to two rounds takes the match.

Online duels ride the reusable room layer: ?net=host opens a room, a friend answers with ?net=join&room=CODE; both boxes run the identical seeded match under lockstep with hash checks every half-second — a desync freezes rather than cheats.
The Node harness now pairs two full online boxes over an in-memory pipe: 67 hash checkpoints, zero desyncs — and it caught a swapped-stream bug the browser alone never would have named.
blobcheck 31/31 and contractcheck 16/16 gate the sim; a Chrome drill drives it with real keys and taps: rotate, slam, die, rematch.
